local function to_e164(phone)
  if phone == nil or phone == '' then return nil, false end
  -- Already valid E.164 US
  if phone:match('^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then
    return phone, false
  end
  -- Extract digits only
  local digits = phone:gsub('%D', '')
  if #digits == 10 then
    return '+1' .. digits, true
  elseif #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then
    return '+' .. digits, true
  else
    -- try if it already starts with + and has right stuff, else best effort
    if phone:match('^%+%d+$') and #digits >= 10 then
      -- leave non-US alone? Task says US numbers. Don't change if we can't make valid US
      return phone, false
    end
    if #digits > 10 then
      -- take last 10?
      local last10 = digits:sub(-10)
      return '+1' .. last10, true
    end
    return phone, false
  end
end
